# Super Pest Control Services

> Super Pest Control Services provides residential and commercial pest management across Rajasthan, including termite, cockroach, centipede, lizard, rodent, mosquito, bed bug, fumigation, and general pest control treatments.

Super Pest Control Services serves homes, businesses, hospitality venues, food and beverage facilities, warehouses, retail locations, offices, and institutions across Rajasthan, including Beawar. Founded in 2001, the company has 25+ years of experience and offices in Jaipur and Beawar.

**Coverage Area:** Ajmer, Alwar, Balotra, Banswara, Baran, Barmer, Beawar, Bharatpur, Bhilwara, Bikaner, Bundi, Chittorgarh, Churu, Dausa, Deeg, Dholpur, Didwana-Kuchaman, Dungarpur, Hanumangarh, Jaipur, Jaisalmer, Jalore, Jhalawar, Jhunjhunu, Jodhpur, Karauli, Khairthal-Tijara, Kota, Kotputli-Behror, Nagaur, Pali, Phalodi, Pratapgarh, Rajsamand, Salumbar, Sawai Madhopur, Sikar, Sirohi, Sri Ganganagar, Tonk, and Udaipur.

**Treatment Methods & Formulations:** Treatment is selected for the site and target pest and follows the current registered product label. Virex II 256 is a disinfectant, not a CIB&RC pesticide formulation. Any WHO listing or prequalification is stated only when verified for the specific product and use.

## Pricing & Active Ingredient Matrix

| Pest Threat | Treatment Methodology | Active CIB&RC Formulation | Starting Price (INR) | Warranty / Residual Protection |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Termites | Inspection-led pre- or post-construction barrier treatment | Imidacloprid 30.5% SC; Chlorpyrifos 20% EC | Starting ₹699* | 10+ years for termite treatment; written warranty terms apply |
| Cockroaches & ants | Targeted gel baiting and localized crevice treatment | Fipronil Gel; Propoxur; Alphacypermethrin | Starting ₹699* | Up to 3 months for general pest control; written terms apply |
| Bed bugs | Inspection-led crack-and-crevice treatment | Alphacypermethrin; Deltamethrin | Starting ₹699* | Up to 3 months for general pest control; written terms apply |
| Rodents | Bait stations, trapping and entry-point exclusion | Zinc Phosphide | Starting ₹699* | Up to 3 months for general pest control; written terms apply |
| Mosquitoes & flies | Suitable fogging and localized residual treatment | Deltamethrin; Alphacypermethrin | Starting ₹699* | Up to 3 months for general pest control; written terms apply |
| Sanitization & disinfection | Surface disinfection using a product selected for the site | Virex II 256 (disinfectant; not a CIB&RC pesticide) | Starting ₹699* | Depends on product and site; confirm in writing |

*Free inspection. Home starting rates: 1 BHK ₹699, 2 BHK ₹799, 3 BHK ₹999, 4 BHK ₹1,150, and 5+ BHK ₹1,250, or ₹0.30 per sq ft. Commercial AMC: Custom AMC Quote. Final scope and price are confirmed after inspection.
